name: raydium
description: Raydium as one mod. Solana's biggest AMM publishes a good API that is painful to read: the pool book is paged and nested, quotes come back in base units, and the thing an LP most wants to know is not in it at all. This module fixes all three. It ranks the whole book by volume, TVL, fees or APR and filters it before it is paged; it resolves symbols to mints so SOL and USDC work anywhere an address does; it prices swaps in whole tokens through Raydium's own router and shows the route hop by hop with the fee at each. It measures what TVL hides — the money actually within 0.5% to 10% of the price, integrated from the pool's published liquidity line, because in a concentrated pool most of the TVL can sit in a range the price left months ago. And it reads concentrated positions off chain: a position is an NFT with no balance and no price, its money living in an account derived from that NFT, so no portfolio API shows it — this derives the account for every NFT in a wallet, decodes the ones that exist, and values them from the tick range and the live pool price, flagging the ones out of range and earning nothing. Swaps are built and never signed: ray_swap_tx returns unsigned bytes for a wallet that holds keys. Seventeen MCP tools, a REST API and a browser console run the same code on one port.

endpoints.swap_tx: POST /swap_tx {wallet, input, output, amount, slippage_bps?, mode?} — returns UNSIGNED transactions

backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib); base58 and the ed25519 curve check for position PDAs are implemented in-tree

auth.reads: open — pool data and the chain are public
auth.writes: there are none. This module holds no keys and signs nothing; ray_swap_tx returns unsigned transactions for a wallet elsewhere to sign

env.PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 50790)
env.RAYDIUM_RPC: Solana RPC for the on-chain reads (positions, wallets). The public endpoint throttles a wallet scan — set your own
env.RAYDIUM_RPC_FALLBACKS: comma-separated endpoints tried when the first is rate-limited
env.RAYDIUM_CACHE_TTL: seconds pool and price reads are cached (default 30)
env.RAYDIUM_TOKEN_SEARCH: 'off' disables the open token index used to resolve symbols Raydium does not publish

peers.solana: signs and sends what ray_swap_tx builds; also the general-purpose chain reader
peers.defi: composes swaps across chains and calls this module's MCP server
